compactRecord.rs: Only auger-drill icebreaker tour ship in the world — the spiral drills literally screw through the Okhotsk pack ice on the cruise.
compactRecord.td: Okhotsk-coast port city; home of the Garinko-go ryūhyō (drift-ice) icebreakers, which crush their way through pack ice with twin auger-drills late Jan-early Apr. Sea-ice museum and Cape Pyūtan watchtower nearby.
